dialogues.speaker: Costentin
dialogues.text: Elegant! Exquisite! I'm entirely enamored with these exhilarating improvisations!

choices.text: I do hope you're working hard.

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: I unquestionably am! I had two double espressos before I started work — my motivation and energy levels are through the roof!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: It's just a shame we don't have enough staff to accompany the guests in their puzzle-solving. All we can do is sit by and provide help when necessary. It could be so much more fun...

choices.text: Try not to get overly "enamored." You need to maintain focus.

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: And I surely will! This attraction may lack the urgency and pressure of battle, but these mechanical challenges are not to be taken lightly!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: In the name of the Blade Dancer, I assure you, I will ensure that our guests will be entertained by an experience both exciting and safe!
